title: Red Warrior Pose Study
description: Three sequential full-body views of a young female character with long dark hair in a dynamic red and black outfit, shown in fighting stances against a plain gray background. The left panel shows a wide combat stance with fists raised, the center shows her mid-jump with one leg forward, and the right shows her stomping with dust kicked up.
prompt: A young female warrior with long flowing dark hair and pale skin, wearing a short red battle dress with black leather corset, red cape, red fingerless gloves, and heavy black combat boots. She has a fierce expression. Shown in three separate panels on a neutral gray background: left in a wide fighting stance with fists up, center leaping forward in an attack pose, right stomping the ground creating dust, all in a cohesive digital painting style.
